summary: Trip hop: 70–95 BPM slow hip hop drums, dark minor chords, cinematic strings, vinyl and tape texture
body: Drums: slow, heavy, sampled-sounding hip hop breaks; dry kick, cracking snare.
Harmony: minor, often i–v–VI or a two-chord loop; strings, Rhodes, organ, a spy-film guitar.
Texture: vinyl crackle, tape saturation, dub echoes; the mood is dark and cinematic.

Apply: pattern/boombap-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-trip-hop-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 70–95 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
